contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman coin: A copper-alloy radiate, contemporary copy, of Carausius dating to the period AD 286 to 293 (Reece Period 14). The obverse legend DIVO CARAVS(SIO?) is notable. The reverse is unclear. There is no clear prototype for this coin. It is probably that the die-engraver was inspired by a DIVO CLAVDIO coin of Claudius II (died AD 270). This coin is included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
